body:
What makes a real estate company good to work for?

Four things, in roughly this order: support (training, a manager who isn’t competing against you, real systems), economics (your take-home after every fee, not the headline split), culture (do people stay?), and brand (does the name help you win business?). A high split at a firm that gives you none of the first three is rarely the best place to work, only the best place to pay fees.

Why Adams, Cameron & Co. ranks for agents working the Lake Helen area

Adams, Cameron & Co. has been the area’s largest brokerage since 1963, with around 300 agents and offices across Volusia and Flagler County. Lake Helen itself is a small, historic town of about 3,000 people, known as Florida’s Victorian Village for its well-preserved late-1800s architecture, and it doesn’t have a brokerage office of its own. Agents who work Lake Helen operate out of the nearest office, Adams, Cameron’s West Volusia location on South Woodland Boulevard in DeLand, minutes away, and draw on a market that has been steadily growing across west Volusia. Agents cite the non-competing managers, the included marketing and technology, the training, and a genuine family culture. That’s why it appears on third-party “best places to work” lists. If support and a trusted local brand matter to you, it’s the established full-service choice for the Lake Helen area.
